name: Readable Alert Digest
summary: Replaces wazuh-maild's raw notifications with one grouped, readable message per run, optionally posts the same digest to Zulip, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Mattermost, LINE or any webhook, and reports its own failures in the console.
summary_zh: 把 wazuh-maild 的原始通知換成分組整理過、讀得完的摘要信，可選擇同時發到 Zulip、Microsoft Teams、Telegram、Slack、Discord、Mattermost、LINE 或任何 webhook，並在主控台回報自己的故障。
author: Jason Tools
notes: The mail channel usually already exists and already works. What stops it being useful is the format: wazuh-maild sends the raw full_log followed by every decoded field printed a second time, and concatenates an hour's alerts into one message. Measured on a live manager, one message ran to seventeen notifications and several thousand lines, and the single genuine detection in it sat underneath fourteen alerts from a build host.

This pack groups alerts that share a rule and an agent, prints the few fields that identify what happened, and sends one message per run. The same seventeen notifications become about forty lines. With more than one group, the message opens with a one-line-per-group summary.

Mail settings are read from the manager's ossec.conf, from the block Wazuh itself reads them from: smtp_server, email_from and email_to from <global>, email_alert_level from <alerts>. 1.3 collected email_to from anywhere in the file, so the recipients of every <reports> block also received every digest. Optional per-node settings live in etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf, which installing or updating never writes. Without that file the digest sends plain SMTP to port 25 exactly as 1.3 did.

PREREQUISITE - turn wazuh-maild off once this is delivering, or both will send. Set email_notification to no and stop the wazuh-maild process; nothing else needs a restart. Do not raise email_alert_level for that purpose: the digest reads it too and would go quiet together with maild. (Notes before 1.4 said to raise it; that advice was wrong.)

Group headings quote the part of the rule description that is common to the whole group. Wazuh interpolates $(field) into a description, so taking the first alert's copy would put one alert's address or path into a heading covering a dozen of them. The cut never falls inside a token; when the shared part is too short (CVE ids), a label such as "Vulnerabilities detected" is used.

The read position is kept by inode and dated file name. At midnight the digest finishes the rotated file, also after monitord has compressed it, then any whole days in between, then today's file. 1.3 jumped to the start of the new file, so on a node that could not deliver, the backlog was thrown away every midnight: 323 level 12+ alerts in nine days on one worker. A failed send leaves the position alone, only complete lines are read (analysisd flushes once a second), and a backlog above 5,000 alerts is sent in parts instead of stalling the reader. The first run records the end of the file and sends nothing.

A notifier cannot announce its own failure by mail, so the script writes JSON status events into the manager's event queue, where rules turn them into console alerts: 131111 delivery failing (level 10, when it starts or changes, then hourly; 1.3 raised the same alert every two minutes, 703 a day on one node), 131112 nothing delivered for two hours (level 12, then every six hours), 131113 alerts skipped for good (level 12), 131116 a configuration that cannot deliver (level 12), 131115 the script crashed (level 10), 131114 delivering again (level 3). 131100 stays for copies of 1.3 or older still running. The optional Zulip channel reports through 131121-131126, the same events marked as Zulip; a refused API key, a bot that may not post or a channel that does not exist is 131126 (level 12), a server error or timeout is 131121 (level 10).

Optional Zulip channel (1.5): with the zulip_* settings, the same digest, repeat hold and daily summary are also posted to a Zulip channel and topic, as Zulip markdown that reads on a phone: one title line per group, the decoded fields in a code block, split into messages under 9,000 characters without cutting a group in two. Mail and Zulip keep separate positions in the alert file, so an outage of one never loses or repeats messages on the other, and a split post that fails halfway resumes with the parts not yet posted. Alerts that are more than zulip_max_backlog (24 hours) old by the time Zulip can take them are counted instead of replayed, and the channel says how many. The API key is read only from a root-only file and never appears in logs, state or alerts. Alert text cannot mention people or disguise a link: markdown in it is escaped and mentions are broken.

Once a day (08:00 by default) each node mails a short summary: alerts by level, digests sent, repeats held back, the delivery state, the most frequent rules, and agents that stopped and did not start again within fifteen minutes. A day without that mail means the digest is not running at all, the one failure no rule can report. Set daily = off to disable it.

Repeat hold: a (rule, host) group already mailed in full within the last 60 minutes is not repeated in full; its alerts are counted and listed in one "still ongoing" line in the next message, or in a short message once the hour is up. A higher level, a new host or a new rule is never held. On one manager's eleven days of level 12+ alerts this would have cut 485 messages to about 221 without leaving any alert out. A (rule, host) pair not seen in 90 days is marked NEW, and the subject says so.

Content: Windows eventchannel alerts show the process, command line, parent, user, file or connection (in 1.3, 93% of one worker's level 12+ alerts printed no fields at all); vulnerability alerts are one line per package with the CVE count and the highest CVSS score. Credentials (passwords and tokens in URLs and command lines, Authorization headers, cookies, private keys) are masked in the mail only; the alert in Wazuh is untouched. Messages carry a Message-ID and Auto-Submitted header, are quoted-printable encoded, and stay below the size at which Gmail cuts a message off.

The schedule is every two minutes rather than immediate. That is deliberate: a burst of forty alerts arrives as one message instead of forty, and two minutes is not the part of an incident response that matters. A lock keeps two overlapping runs from mailing the same alerts.

Container image scan results (jt-container-vuln) are listed one line per image, with the image's counts and containers, instead of three samples and "N more": the scanner's first run reports every image on a host at once.

Certificate checks (SMTP with tls = verify, and Zulip) load the system CA bundle when the interpreter has none. Wazuh's own framework python under /var/ossec ships with an empty CA store, so a schedule naming it failed every verified connection.

Zulip posts use Zulip's own markdown and are laid out for a phone: a coloured mark per level and the title in bold, then a two-column table of the short values (host, address, time, rule linked to the dashboard, MITRE, short decoded fields). Zulip never wraps a table cell, so a value wider than a phone's column (about 28 characters, 20 in code) goes into a quoted block below the table instead. The raw log is collapsed in a spoiler as wrapped text (a code block there would scroll sideways), or shown as a quote when nothing else was decoded. Italics are *x*; Zulip shows _x_ with the underscores. --test zulip includes an invented alert to show the layout.

Zulip does not honour backslash escapes, so alert text is made inert without them: asterisks and backticks become look-alike characters and a zero-width space splits link syntax, mentions, LaTeX and strike-through. 1.7 and 1.8 showed log lines as "sshd\[4242\]".

Each Zulip card starts with a row of squares in the level's colour (red 14+, orange 12-13, yellow 10-11, blue below) above the bold title: Zulip has no headings or larger text, and the bar is what makes the start of each alert stand out in a long post.

Agent starts, stops and disconnections are recognised by the event text, not by rule ID. A site rule that takes over 503 (as one did on a live manager) hid every start, so 43 agents restarted on purpose were listed in the daily summary as stopped; a new agent's first start is 501. The Zulip daily summary is laid out like the alert cards: a green or red bar, a status table, alert counts by level and the most frequent rules as wrapped lines, and a long list of agents collapsed.

A source address in a message names the agent it belongs to, as 192.0.2.10 (web1): the digest learns each agent's address from the alert lines it reads, including those below the mail level, and keeps the table in var/jt-alert-digest.agents. Agents registered without a fixed address (any) are not named.

Written for Wazuh 4.8 to 4.14, which write logs/alerts/alerts.json; Wazuh 5.0 has no such file, and there the digest raises a configuration alert instead of staying silent. Runs on the manager's own python3 (3.8 or later), standard library only.

1.12.1: alerts from jt-runtime-vuln's version check and jt-zimbra's baseline check are filed under the host they name, as jt-php's have been since 1.12 (they are the manager's own events and carry the host in jt_runtime.agent_name and jt_zimbra_baseline.agent_name).

1.13: seven more optional channels, each configured only by its own settings in jt-alert-digest.conf: Microsoft Teams (a Workflows webhook, as Adaptive Cards: each group in a container tinted by level, values as a fact set, the log behind a Show log toggle), Telegram (a bot, HTML with the log in a collapsed quote), Slack (an incoming webhook, Block Kit), Discord (a channel webhook, one embed per group in the level's colour), Mattermost (an incoming webhook, markdown), LINE (Messaging API push, plain text) and a generic webhook (a documented JSON document, schema jt-alert-digest/1, for a SOAR, a ticket queue or a script). Each works as the Zulip channel does: its own position in the alert file, repeat hold, outbox and daily summary, so an outage or crash of one never loses or repeats the messages of mail or of another channel, and a split post that fails halfway resumes with the parts not yet posted.

1.13 status rules, ten IDs a channel, each a child of the mail rule for the same event: Teams 131131-131136, Telegram 131141-131146, Slack 131151-131156, Discord 131161-131166, Mattermost 131171-131176, webhook 131181-131186, LINE 131191-131196 (x1 cannot post, L10; x2 nothing posted for two hours, L12; x3 alerts skipped, L12; x4 posting again, L3; x5 crashed, L10; x6 refused credentials or configuration, L12). A message the platform rejects as malformed (Discord 50035, Slack invalid_blocks, Telegram "can't parse entities" after a plain-text retry) is dropped after three tries and reported as skipped, rather than blocking the channel for good; the mail digest still has those alerts.

Alert text is attacker-influenced, so each channel is escaped for what its platform acts on: Slack's &, < and > (no <!channel>, <@user> or <url|text> can be formed), Telegram's HTML and its @username and /command entities, Discord's markdown by backslash plus allowed_mentions with an empty parse list, the markdown subset and {{DATE()}} functions of Adaptive Cards, every @word in Mattermost; LINE plain text interprets nothing. Webhook addresses are credentials in themselves, so Teams, Slack, Discord and Mattermost addresses, bot tokens and keys are read only from files owned by root with mode 600 and never through a symbolic link (from 1.13 the same applies to smtp_password_file and zulip_api_key_file), and they never appear in logs, the state file, status events or error texts. Redirects are refused, so a token is never carried to another host; certificates are verified.

Per channel: <name>_level posts from that level up (ignoring rule.mail) instead of the mail level, for example a phone channel for level 14 only; <name>_daily = off drops that channel's daily summary; <name>_max_backlog (24 hours by default) bounds what is replayed after an outage; <name>_ca_file and <name>_tls_verify for a server with a private CA. zulip_level and zulip_daily work the same way.

LINE counts every push message against the channel's monthly quota, once per recipient, so a group of ten people is ten messages. The digest therefore sends each run as one request of up to five text messages, which LINE counts as one, and retries with the same X-Line-Retry-Key so a retry is never counted twice. Set line_level and keep the repeat hold on; --test line also counts.

Generic webhook: POST of JSON with schema, kind (digest, daily or test), node, level, total, groups (rule_id, level, title, agent name/id/ip, count, first, last, new, mitre, link, samples as label/value pairs, redacted as in the mail) and held repeats. Headers: X-JT-Event, X-JT-Delivery (the same on every retry, for de-duplication) and, with webhook_hmac_key_file, X-JT-Timestamp and X-JT-Signature = sha256= hex HMAC-SHA256(key, timestamp + "." + body). Nothing in it is escaped: the receiver must treat every string as untrusted text.
notes_zh: 郵件管道通常本來就有、也本來就通。讓它沒有用的是格式：wazuh-maild 會把 full_log 原文加上每個解碼欄位再印一次，還把一小時內的告警串成一封。在正式機實測，一封信有 17 則通知、數千行，而其中唯一真正的偵測被壓在 14 則來自建置主機的告警底下。
這個套件把相同（規則, 主機）的告警折成一組，只留能說明發生什麼事的欄位，每次執行送一封。同樣那 17 則會變成約 40 行。超過一組時，信的開頭先列出每組一行的摘要。

郵件設定從 manager 的 ossec.conf 讀，而且只從 Wazuh 自己讀它的那個區塊讀：smtp_server、email_from、email_to 來自 <global>，email_alert_level 來自 <alerts>。1.3 會從整個檔案收集 email_to，所以每個 <reports> 區塊的收件人也會收到每一封摘要信。各節點的選用設定放在 etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf，安裝或更新永遠不會寫這個檔案。沒有這個檔案時，行為與 1.3 完全相同：以一般 SMTP 寄到 25 埠。
前提條件 - 確認摘要信送得到之後要把 wazuh-maild 關掉，否則兩邊都會寄。把 email_notification 設成 no，再停掉 wazuh-maild 程序即可，其他都不需要重啟。不要用調高 email_alert_level 的方式關：摘要信也讀這個值，會跟著 maild 一起安靜。（1.4 之前的說明寫的是調高它，那是錯的。）
分組標題取的是整組描述的共同部分。Wazuh 會把 $(欄位) 內插進 description，所以直接用第一則的描述，會把只屬於某一則的位址或路徑寫在涵蓋十幾則的標題上。切點不會落在一個詞的中間；共同部分太短時（例如 CVE 編號），改用「Vulnerabilities detected」這類標籤。

讀取位置以 inode 加上日期檔名記錄。午夜換檔時，先把換出去的檔案讀完（monitord 壓縮成 .gz 之後也可以），再讀中間整天的檔案，最後才是今天的檔案。1.3 會直接跳到新檔案的開頭，所以一個寄不出去的節點每到午夜就把積壓的告警丟掉：某台 worker 九天內有 323 筆 level 12 以上就這樣消失。寄送失敗不會推進讀取位置；只讀完整的行（analysisd 每秒才寫出一次）；積壓超過 5,000 則時分批寄出，而不是讓讀取停擺。第一次執行只記下告警檔的結尾、不寄任何東西。

通知程式沒辦法用通知宣告自己壞了，所以腳本把 JSON 狀態事件寫進 manager 的事件佇列，由規則轉成主控台告警：131111 寄送失敗（level 10，開始或原因改變時一次，之後每小時一次；1.3 每兩分鐘一次，某節點一天 703 筆）、131112 兩小時都沒送達（level 12，之後每六小時一次）、131113 有告警被永久跳過（level 12）、131116 設定使寄送不可能（level 12）、131115 腳本當掉（level 10）、131114 恢復寄送（level 3）。131100 保留給仍在執行 1.3 或更舊版本的節點。選用的 Zulip 頻道以 131121-131126 回報，是同樣的事件、標示為 Zulip；API 金鑰被拒、bot 不能發言或頻道不存在是 131126（level 12），伺服器錯誤或逾時是 131121（level 10）。

選用的 Zulip 頻道（1.5）：設定 zulip_* 後，同樣的摘要、重複壓制與每日摘要也會發到指定的 Zulip 頻道與話題，以手機上讀得順的 Zulip markdown 呈現：每組一行標題、解碼欄位放在程式碼區塊裡，切成每則 9,000 字元以下的訊息，且不會把一組切成兩半。郵件與 Zulip 在告警檔中各有自己的讀取位置，所以其中一邊中斷時，另一邊的訊息不會遺失也不會重複；分段發送中途失敗時，下一次只補發還沒發出的部分。Zulip 恢復時已超過 zulip_max_backlog（24 小時）的告警只計數、不重播，並在頻道裡說明有幾則。API 金鑰只從僅 root 可讀的檔案讀取，絕不出現在記錄、狀態檔或告警中。告警內容無法標註（mention）任何人或偽裝連結：其中的 markdown 會被跳脫，mention 會被打斷。
每個節點每天寄一封簡短的摘要（預設 08:00）：各等級告警數、寄出幾封、壓下多少重複、寄送狀態、最常出現的規則，以及停止後十五分鐘內沒有再啟動的 agent。哪天沒收到這封信，就代表摘要信根本沒在跑 —— 這是任何規則都無法回報的故障。設定 daily = off 可關閉。

重複壓制：同一組（規則, 主機）在 60 分鐘內已完整寄過的，不再完整重寄；這些告警會被計數，在下一封信裡以一行「still ongoing」列出，或在一小時到期時寄一封簡短的信。等級升高、新主機、新規則永遠不會被壓下。以某台 manager 十一天的 level 12 以上告警試算，485 封會變成約 221 封，而且沒有任何告警被省略。90 天內沒出現過的（規則, 主機）組合標示 NEW，主旨也會註明。

內容：Windows eventchannel 告警會列出程序、命令列、父程序、使用者、檔案或連線（1.3 時某台 worker 的 level 12 以上告警有 93% 一個欄位都沒印）；弱點告警每個套件一行，附 CVE 數量與最高 CVSS 分數。帳密類資訊（網址與命令列中的密碼和 token、Authorization 標頭、cookie、私鑰）只在信裡遮蔽，Wazuh 裡的告警不受影響。信件帶有 Message-ID 與 Auto-Submitted 標頭、以 quoted-printable 編碼，並維持在 Gmail 會截斷的大小以下。
排程是每兩分鐘一次而不是即時。這是刻意的：40 筆的爆量會變成一封信而不是 40 封，而那兩分鐘不是事件應變中要緊的部分。另有鎖定機制，避免兩次重疊的執行寄出同一批告警。
容器映像掃描結果（jt-container-vuln）每個映像列一行（含弱點數量與容器名稱），不再只列三筆範例加「還有 N 筆」：掃描程式第一次執行時，一台主機的所有映像會同時回報。
憑證檢查（SMTP 設為 tls = verify 時，以及 Zulip）在直譯器沒有 CA 憑證時會載入系統的 CA 憑證庫。Wazuh 自帶在 /var/ossec 底下的 framework python 的 CA 憑證庫是空的，排程若指向它，每一個需要驗證憑證的連線都會失敗。

Zulip 訊息改用 Zulip 本身的 markdown，並以手機為準排版：每個等級一個顏色標記、標題粗體，接著是兩欄表格，放短的值（主機、位址、時間、連到 dashboard 的規則、MITRE、短的解碼欄位）。Zulip 的表格儲存格不會換行，所以超過手機欄寬的值（約 28 個字元，程式碼約 20 個）改放在表格下方的引用區塊。原始記錄以會換行的文字收在可展開的區塊（放程式碼區塊會要左右捲動），沒有其他解碼欄位時直接以引用顯示。斜體用 *x*；Zulip 會把 _x_ 連底線一起顯示。--test zulip 會附一則虛構的告警，讓人先看到版面。
Zulip 不支援反斜線跳脫，所以告警文字改用其他方式失去格式作用：星號與反引號換成外觀相近的字元，連結語法、@ 提及、LaTeX 與刪除線以零寬空白拆開。1.7、1.8 會把記錄顯示成「sshd\[4242\]」。
每張 Zulip 卡片在粗體標題上方加一排與等級同色的方塊（14 以上紅、12-13 橘、10-11 黃、其餘藍）：Zulip 沒有標題語法也不能放大字，長訊息裡靠這條色塊看出每則告警從哪裡開始。
agent 的啟動、停止與斷線改依事件文字判斷，不再看規則 ID。站台若有規則接走 503（正式機上就有），所有啟動事件都看不到，結果 43 台刻意重啟的 agent 在每日摘要裡被列為已停止；新 agent 的第一次啟動則是 501。Zulip 的每日摘要改成和告警卡片相同的排版：綠色或紅色色塊、狀態表格、各等級告警數與最常見規則以會換行的文字列出，agent 清單太長時收合。
訊息裡的來源位址會標出它屬於哪個 agent，例如 192.0.2.10 (web1)：摘要程式從讀到的告警（包括低於郵件等級的）學到每個 agent 的位址，表格存在 var/jt-alert-digest.agents。註冊時沒有固定位址（any）的 agent 不會被標出。
適用於會寫 logs/alerts/alerts.json 的 Wazuh 4.8 至 4.14；Wazuh 5.0 沒有這個檔案，在那裡摘要信會發出設定錯誤的告警，而不是默不作聲。使用 manager 本身的 python3（3.8 以上），只用標準函式庫。
1.12.1：jt-runtime-vuln 的版本檢查與 jt-zimbra 的基準清單檢查所產生的告警，也和 jt-php（1.12 起）一樣歸在事件所指的主機底下（它們是管理端自己的事件，主機寫在 jt_runtime.agent_name 與 jt_zimbra_baseline.agent_name）。

1.13：新增七個選用頻道，各自只由 jt-alert-digest.conf 裡自己的設定啟用：Microsoft Teams（Workflows webhook，以 Adaptive Card 呈現：每組放在依等級上色的容器、欄位用 fact set、記錄收在「Show log」按鈕後）、Telegram（bot，HTML，記錄放在可展開的引用）、Slack（incoming webhook，Block Kit）、Discord（頻道 webhook，每組一個依等級上色的 embed）、Mattermost（incoming webhook，markdown）、LINE（Messaging API push，純文字），以及通用 webhook（有文件的 JSON，schema jt-alert-digest/1，給 SOAR、工單系統或腳本）。每個頻道都和 Zulip 一樣：在告警檔中有自己的讀取位置、重複壓制、待送匣與每日摘要，所以任何一個頻道中斷或當掉，都不會讓郵件或其他頻道的訊息遺失或重複；分段發送中途失敗時，下一次只補發還沒發出的部分。

1.13 的狀態規則，每個頻道十個 ID，各自是同一事件郵件規則的子規則：Teams 131131-131136、Telegram 131141-131146、Slack 131151-131156、Discord 131161-131166、Mattermost 131171-131176、webhook 131181-131186、LINE 131191-131196（個位數 1 發不出去 L10；2 兩小時都沒送達 L12；3 有告警被跳過 L12；4 恢復 L3；5 當掉 L10；6 憑證或設定被拒 L12）。平台把訊息本身判為格式錯誤時（Discord 50035、Slack invalid_blocks、Telegram 改送純文字後仍「can't parse entities」），同一則訊息試三次後丟棄並以「跳過」回報，不讓頻道永遠卡住；這些告警在郵件摘要裡仍然有。

告警文字可能受攻擊者影響，所以每個頻道都依平台會解讀的語法處理：Slack 的 &、<、>（因此組不出 <!channel>、<@user> 或 <url|文字>）、Telegram 的 HTML 以及 @username 與 /指令、Discord 以反斜線跳脫 markdown 並設定 allowed_mentions 為空清單、Adaptive Card 的 markdown 子集與 {{DATE()}} 函式、Mattermost 的每個 @詞；LINE 純文字不做任何解讀。webhook 網址本身就是憑證，所以 Teams、Slack、Discord、Mattermost 的網址，以及 bot token 與金鑰，都只從屬於 root、權限 600 的檔案讀取，且不經過符號連結（1.13 起 smtp_password_file 與 zulip_api_key_file 也一樣），絕不出現在記錄、狀態檔、狀態事件或錯誤訊息中。不跟隨重新導向，token 不會被帶到其他主機；會驗證憑證。

各頻道可個別設定：<名稱>_level 從該等級起發送（不看 rule.mail），取代郵件等級，例如手機頻道只收 level 14；<名稱>_daily = off 不發該頻道的每日摘要；<名稱>_max_backlog（預設 24 小時）限制中斷後補發的範圍；<名稱>_ca_file 與 <名稱>_tls_verify 用於私有 CA 的伺服器。zulip_level、zulip_daily 用法相同。
LINE 的每一則 push 都會計入頻道的每月訊息額度，而且是依收件人計算：十個人的群組就是十則。因此摘要每次執行只送一個請求、最多五則文字訊息（LINE 算一則），重試時使用同一個 X-Line-Retry-Key，重試不會被重複計算。請設定 line_level 並保留重複壓制；--test line 也會計入額度。

通用 webhook：以 POST 送出 JSON，含 schema、kind（digest、daily 或 test）、node、level、total、groups（rule_id、level、title、agent 名稱/ID/IP、count、first、last、new、mitre、link、samples 為 label/value 配對，與郵件相同已遮蔽帳密）與 held 重複項目。標頭：X-JT-Event、X-JT-Delivery（同一份文件每次重試都相同，可用來去重），設定 webhook_hmac_key_file 時另有 X-JT-Timestamp 與 X-JT-Signature = sha256= 加上 HMAC-SHA256(金鑰, timestamp + "." + body) 的十六進位。內容完全不跳脫：接收端必須把每個字串都當成不可信的文字。

scripts.name: jt-alert-digest.py
scripts.description: Groups new alerts and sends one readable message, using the mail settings already in ossec.conf, optionally also to Zulip, Teams, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Mattermost, LINE or a webhook; reports its own failures to the manager

setup.title: Install on every node that writes alerts, and reload the ruleset on each
setup.title_zh: 在每個會寫告警的節點各裝一份，並在每個節點重新載入規則
setup.body: Each cluster node writes only the alerts of the agents it processes, so in a cluster this must run on every node; Windows agents are usually on a worker. The installer schedules it on the node you install from; on each worker, copy the script and the cron file across, and the settings file below if you use one. The cluster copies the rule file to the workers but does not reload their analysisd: use Reload ruleset afterwards, or the worker's status events are not recognised (1.5 adds 131121-131126 for Zulip, 1.13 adds 131131-131196 for the other channels).
setup.body_zh: 每個叢集節點只寫入它負責的 agent 的告警，所以叢集中每個節點都要執行；Windows agent 通常在 worker 上。安裝程式只會在你安裝的那個節點排程；每個 worker 請把腳本與排程檔複製過去，若有使用下方的設定檔也一併複製。叢集會把規則檔同步到 worker，但不會重新載入 worker 的 analysisd：之後請按「重新載入規則集」，否則 worker 的狀態事件不會被辨識（1.5 新增 Zulip 用的 131121-131126，1.13 新增其他頻道用的 131131-131196）。

setup.title: Remove a hand-made schedule left from an earlier version
setup.title_zh: 移除早期版本留下的手動排程
setup.body: Before the tool scheduled scripts, the digest was sometimes installed by hand with its own cron file, often carrying --dashboard on the command line. If such a file is still there next to the tool's jt-jt-alert-digest, both run and an old copy keeps mailing in the 1.3 format. Keep only the tool's file, and move any --dashboard value into the settings file.
setup.body_zh: 在工具會排程腳本之前，摘要信有時是手動安裝、有自己的排程檔，命令列上常帶著 --dashboard。若這種檔案還和工具寫的 jt-jt-alert-digest 並存，兩者都會執行，舊的那份會繼續用 1.3 的格式寄信。只保留工具寫的那份，並把 --dashboard 的值移到設定檔。
setup.code:
grep -l jt-alert-digest /etc/cron.d/*
# keep /etc/cron.d/jt-jt-alert-digest, remove any other file listed
setup.verify: grep -l jt-alert-digest /etc/cron.d/* lists only /etc/cron.d/jt-jt-alert-digest on every node.
setup.verify_zh: 每個節點上 grep -l jt-alert-digest /etc/cron.d/* 只列出 /etc/cron.d/jt-jt-alert-digest。

setup.title: Put a link to the dashboard in each message
setup.title_zh: 在每封信裡附上主控台連結
setup.body: The digest can end with a link to your Wazuh dashboard, and from 1.4 each group also links to its own alerts (that rule, that agent, the minutes around them) in the 4.9+ threat-hunting view; set link = off to drop those. Put the setting in the settings file rather than on the cron line: installing or updating the pack rewrites the cron entry from the pack, and never touches this file. Each node reads its own copy.
setup.body_zh: 摘要信可以在結尾附上 Wazuh 主控台的連結；1.4 起每一組還會連到它自己的告警（該規則、該 agent、前後幾分鐘），使用 4.9 以上的 threat-hunting 畫面；設定 link = off 可取消。請寫在設定檔裡，不要加在排程那一行：安裝或更新套件時會依套件重寫排程，但永遠不會動到這個檔案。每個節點讀自己的那一份。
setup.verify: The dry run prints the link as the last line of the message when there are alerts to report.
setup.verify_zh: 有告警可報時，試跑會在訊息最後一行印出這個連結。

setup.title: Check that the mail server accepts the node
setup.title_zh: 確認郵件伺服器接受該節點
setup.body: A failed send is not lost: the read position stays put and the next run retries, and the console shows rule 131111, then 131112 after two hours. Many mail servers refuse a sender without a reverse DNS (PTR) record, which is the usual reason one node delivers and another does not. Query the DNS server the mail server uses, not the node's own resolver: a line in the node's /etc/hosts answers locally and hides the missing record.
setup.body_zh: 寄送失敗不會遺失：讀取位置不前進、下一輪重試，主控台會出現規則 131111，兩小時後是 131112。許多郵件伺服器會拒收沒有反向 DNS（PTR）記錄的來源，這通常就是「一台寄得出去、另一台寄不出去」的原因。請查詢郵件伺服器所用的 DNS，而不是節點自己的解析器：節點 /etc/hosts 裡的一行會在本機回答，把缺少的記錄藏起來。

setup.title: Test delivery from each node with --check and --test
setup.title_zh: 在每個節點用 --check 與 --test 測試寄送
setup.body: --check prints the settings the node will use and walks the SMTP conversation up to RCPT TO for every recipient, then resets it: nothing is delivered and nothing is written, and the mail server's exact answer is printed (a 450 for a missing PTR shows here on the first try instead of after the first alert). --test then sends one marked test message. Run both on every node.
setup.body_zh: --check 會列出該節點將使用的設定，並把 SMTP 對話走到每個收件人的 RCPT TO 後重設：不寄出、不寫入任何東西，並印出郵件伺服器的原始回應（缺 PTR 的 450 會在第一次就顯示，而不是等第一則告警）。接著用 --test 寄一封標示為測試的信。每個節點都要各跑一次。
setup.verify: --check ends with "the server accepts this node and every recipient", and the test message arrives.
setup.verify_zh: --check 最後一行是「the server accepts this node and every recipient」，而且測試信有收到。

setup.title: Optional: submit through port 587 with STARTTLS and a login
setup.title_zh: 選用：改由 587 埠以 STARTTLS 加帳號登入送信
setup.body: Wazuh's own mail daemon can only send plain SMTP without authentication. The digest can also submit like a mail client, per node, which helps a node the mail server would otherwise refuse (no PTR record) and keeps alert content off the wire in clear text. tls is none (default), may (STARTTLS when offered), required, verify (also checks the certificate; tls_ca_file for a private CA) or implicit (TLS from the first byte, port 465). A password is only sent over required, verify or implicit, and only from a file that belongs to root with mode 600; never put it in the settings file, which is world-readable.
setup.body_zh: Wazuh 自己的郵件 daemon 只能以不驗證的一般 SMTP 送信。摘要信可以在各節點像郵件軟體一樣投遞，可以讓原本會被郵件伺服器拒收的節點（例如缺 PTR）送得出去，也讓告警內容不再以明文在網路上傳送。tls 可設 none（預設）、may（伺服器提供時才用 STARTTLS）、required、verify（另外檢查憑證；私有 CA 用 tls_ca_file）或 implicit（一連線就是 TLS，465 埠）。密碼只會在 required、verify、implicit 下送出，而且只從屬於 root、權限 600 的檔案讀取；不要寫在設定檔裡，那個檔案每個人都讀得到。
setup.code:
install -m 600 -o root -g root /dev/null /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.secret
printf '%s\n' '<password>' > /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.secret
cat >> /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf <<'EOF'
smtp_port = 587
tls = required
smtp_user = <sender-account>
smtp_password_file = /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.secret
EOF
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --check
setup.verify: --check shows "STARTTLS: encrypted" and "AUTH: accepted" before MAIL FROM.
setup.verify_zh: --check 在 MAIL FROM 之前顯示「STARTTLS: encrypted」與「AUTH: accepted」。

setup.title: Optional: tune repeats, the daily summary and exclusions
setup.title_zh: 選用：調整重複壓制、每日摘要與排除
setup.body: All in the settings file, per node, and all optional: repeat (minutes a group is held after a full mail, 60 by default, 0 turns the hold off), daily (time of the daily summary, 08:00 by default, off to disable), level (mail from this level up, ignoring the rules' own mail flag; by default email_alert_level and rule.mail decide, exactly as for wazuh-maild), to (recipients for this node instead of email_to), exclude_rules and exclude_agents (never mailed, still counted in the daily summary), max_per_hour (0 by default: no limit; above it, alerts wait for the next allowed run and are never dropped). Unknown or invalid values are listed by --check and in the daily summary, and the default is used.
setup.body_zh: 都寫在各節點的設定檔裡，而且都是選用：repeat（完整寄出後壓制同一組幾分鐘，預設 60，設 0 關閉）、daily（每日摘要的時間，預設 08:00，off 關閉）、level（從這個等級起寄出，忽略規則本身的 mail 旗標；預設由 email_alert_level 與 rule.mail 決定，與 wazuh-maild 完全相同）、to（這個節點改寄給這些收件人，取代 email_to）、exclude_rules 與 exclude_agents（不寄出，但仍計入每日摘要）、max_per_hour（預設 0 不限制；超過時告警等到下一次允許的執行，絕不丟棄）。不認得或無效的值會由 --check 與每日摘要列出，並改用預設值。

setup.title: Optional: also post the digest to a Zulip channel
setup.title_zh: 選用：同時把摘要發到 Zulip 頻道
setup.body: In Zulip, create a bot (Personal settings > Bots > Add a new bot, type Generic bot) and note its e-mail address and API key. The bot must be allowed to post in the channel: subscribe it to the channel (required for a private channel), and if the channel restricts who may post, include the bot. On every node that runs the digest, put the API key alone on the first line of /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-zulip.key, owned by root:root with mode 600 (the digest refuses the file otherwise), and add the zulip_ lines below to /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf. zulip_url must be https; the certificate is verified (zulip_ca_file for a private CA). zulip_summary_topic (optional) sends the daily summary to another topic. Mail is not affected: nothing changes until these lines exist, and either channel keeps working when the other fails. Then run --check, which logs in and finds the channel without posting, and --test zulip, which posts one message and sends no mail.
setup.body_zh: 在 Zulip 建立一個 bot（個人設定 > Bots > 新增 bot，類型選 Generic bot），記下它的電子郵件地址與 API 金鑰。bot 必須能在該頻道發言：把 bot 訂閱到頻道（私人頻道必須訂閱），若頻道限制誰能發言，也要包含這個 bot。在每個執行摘要信的節點上，把 API 金鑰單獨放在 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-zulip.key 的第一行，擁有者 root:root、權限 600（否則摘要信會拒用這個檔案），並把下方的 zulip_ 設定加進 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf。zulip_url 必須是 https，會驗證憑證（私有 CA 用 zulip_ca_file）。zulip_summary_topic（選用）可把每日摘要發到另一個話題。郵件不受影響：在加入這些設定之前什麼都不會改變，而且任一頻道失敗時另一個照常運作。接著執行 --check（會登入並找到頻道，但不發文）與 --test zulip（發一則測試訊息，不寄信）。
setup.code:
( umask 077; read -rs -p 'Zulip API key: ' K; echo; printf '%s\n' "$K" > /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-zulip.key )
chown root:root /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-zulip.key
chmod 600 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-zulip.key
cat >> /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf <<'EOF'
zulip_url = https://<zulip-host>
zulip_email = <bot-email>
zulip_api_key_file = /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-zulip.key
zulip_stream = <channel>
zulip_topic = <topic>
EOF
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --check
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --test zulip
setup.verify: --check ends its Zulip part with "the bot is accepted", and --test zulip posts one message to the topic.
setup.verify_zh: --check 的 Zulip 部分最後顯示「the bot is accepted」，而且 --test zulip 在該話題發出一則訊息。

setup.title: Optional: post the digest to a Microsoft Teams channel
setup.title_zh: 選用：把摘要發到 Microsoft Teams 頻道
setup.body: In the Teams channel, open ... > Workflows and pick the template "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received" (Office 365 connectors were retired; Workflows takes the same Adaptive Card), choose the team and channel, and copy the address it shows. That address is the credential: anyone who has it can post to the channel. On every node that runs the digest, put the value alone on the first line of a file owned by root:root with mode 600 (the digest refuses it otherwise, and refuses a symbolic link), add the lines below to /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf, then run --check and --test teams, which posts one message and sends no mail. Mail and the other channels are not affected.
setup.body_zh: 在 Teams 頻道點「...」>「工作流程」，選範本「收到 webhook 要求時張貼到頻道」（Office 365 連接器已停用，Workflows 收同樣的 Adaptive Card），選擇團隊與頻道，複製顯示的網址。這個網址就是憑證：拿到的人都能在這個頻道發文。在每個執行摘要的節點上，把這個值單獨放在檔案第一行，擁有者 root:root、權限 600（否則摘要會拒用，也拒用符號連結），把下方設定加進 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf，再執行 --check 與 --test teams（發一則測試訊息，不寄信）。郵件與其他頻道不受影響。
setup.code:
( umask 077; read -rs -p 'Teams workflow URL: ' V; echo; printf '%s\n' "$V" > /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-teams.url )
chown root:root /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-teams.url
chmod 600 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-teams.url
echo 'teams_url_file = /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-teams.url' >> /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --check
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --test teams
setup.verify: --test teams posts one card (there is no read-only way to check a workflow address, so --check only validates the settings).
setup.verify_zh: --test teams 發出一張卡片（workflow 網址沒有唯讀的檢查方式，所以 --check 只驗證設定）。

setup.title: Optional: post the digest to a Telegram group or channel
setup.title_zh: 選用：把摘要發到 Telegram 群組或頻道
setup.body: Create a bot with @BotFather (/newbot) and note its token. Add the bot to the group (to a channel, as an administrator). The chat id of a group starts with -100: send any message in the group, then read chat.id from https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/getUpdates; a public channel can be given as @channelname. telegram_thread_id (optional) posts to one topic of a forum group. On every node that runs the digest, put the value alone on the first line of a file owned by root:root with mode 600 (the digest refuses it otherwise, and refuses a symbolic link), add the lines below to /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf, then run --check and --test telegram, which posts one message and sends no mail. Mail and the other channels are not affected.
setup.body_zh: 用 @BotFather（/newbot）建立 bot，記下 token。把 bot 加入群組（頻道則要設為管理員）。群組的 chat id 以 -100 開頭：在群組裡隨便發一則訊息，再從 https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/getUpdates 讀出 chat.id；公開頻道可以直接寫 @頻道名稱。telegram_thread_id（選用）可發到論壇群組的某個話題。在每個執行摘要的節點上，把這個值單獨放在檔案第一行，擁有者 root:root、權限 600（否則摘要會拒用，也拒用符號連結），把下方設定加進 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf，再執行 --check 與 --test telegram（發一則測試訊息，不寄信）。郵件與其他頻道不受影響。
setup.code:
( umask 077; read -rs -p 'Telegram bot token: ' V; echo; printf '%s\n' "$V" > /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-telegram.token )
chown root:root /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-telegram.token
chmod 600 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-telegram.token
cat >> /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf <<'EOF'
telegram_token_file = /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-telegram.token
telegram_chat_id = <-100...>
EOF
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --check
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --test telegram
setup.verify: --check shows "telegram auth: accepted as @<bot>" and the chat's title; --test telegram posts one message.
setup.verify_zh: --check 顯示「telegram auth: accepted as @<bot>」與聊天室名稱；--test telegram 發出一則訊息。

setup.title: Optional: post the digest to a Slack channel
setup.title_zh: 選用：把摘要發到 Slack 頻道
setup.body: At api.slack.com/apps create an app (From scratch), open Incoming Webhooks, switch them on, choose Add New Webhook to Workspace, pick the channel and copy the address (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...). The address is the credential. On every node that runs the digest, put the value alone on the first line of a file owned by root:root with mode 600 (the digest refuses it otherwise, and refuses a symbolic link), add the lines below to /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf, then run --check and --test slack, which posts one message and sends no mail. Mail and the other channels are not affected.
setup.body_zh: 在 api.slack.com/apps 建立 app（From scratch），進入 Incoming Webhooks 並開啟，按 Add New Webhook to Workspace、選擇頻道，複製網址（https://hooks.slack.com/services/...）。這個網址就是憑證。在每個執行摘要的節點上，把這個值單獨放在檔案第一行，擁有者 root:root、權限 600（否則摘要會拒用，也拒用符號連結），把下方設定加進 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf，再執行 --check 與 --test slack（發一則測試訊息，不寄信）。郵件與其他頻道不受影響。
setup.code:
( umask 077; read -rs -p 'Slack webhook URL: ' V; echo; printf '%s\n' "$V" > /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-slack.url )
chown root:root /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-slack.url
chmod 600 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-slack.url
echo 'slack_url_file = /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-slack.url' >> /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --check
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --test slack
setup.verify: --check shows "slack result: the webhook exists" (it sends an empty message, which Slack refuses without posting); --test slack posts one message.
setup.verify_zh: --check 顯示「slack result: the webhook exists」（它送出一則空訊息，Slack 會拒收、不會貼出）；--test slack 發出一則訊息。

setup.title: Optional: post the digest to a Discord channel
setup.title_zh: 選用：把摘要發到 Discord 頻道
setup.body: In Server Settings > Integrations > Webhooks choose New Webhook, pick the channel and Copy Webhook URL. The address is the credential. Messages are sent with allowed_mentions empty, so no alert can notify anyone. On every node that runs the digest, put the value alone on the first line of a file owned by root:root with mode 600 (the digest refuses it otherwise, and refuses a symbolic link), add the lines below to /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf, then run --check and --test discord, which posts one message and sends no mail. Mail and the other channels are not affected.
setup.body_zh: 在「伺服器設定」>「整合」>「Webhook」新增 Webhook、選擇頻道，按「複製 Webhook 網址」。這個網址就是憑證。訊息送出時 allowed_mentions 為空，任何告警都無法通知（mention）任何人。在每個執行摘要的節點上，把這個值單獨放在檔案第一行，擁有者 root:root、權限 600（否則摘要會拒用，也拒用符號連結），把下方設定加進 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf，再執行 --check 與 --test discord（發一則測試訊息，不寄信）。郵件與其他頻道不受影響。
setup.code:
( umask 077; read -rs -p 'Discord webhook URL: ' V; echo; printf '%s\n' "$V" > /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-discord.url )
chown root:root /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-discord.url
chmod 600 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-discord.url
echo 'discord_url_file = /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-discord.url' >> /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --check
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --test discord
setup.verify: --check shows the webhook's name and channel id; --test discord posts one message.
setup.verify_zh: --check 顯示 webhook 名稱與頻道 ID；--test discord 發出一則訊息。

setup.title: Optional: post the digest to a Mattermost channel
setup.title_zh: 選用：把摘要發到 Mattermost 頻道
setup.body: In Mattermost choose Integrations > Incoming Webhooks > Add Incoming Webhook (a system admin may first have to enable incoming webhooks in the System Console) and pick the channel; copy the address (https://<server>/hooks/...). mattermost_channel (optional) overrides the channel when the webhook is not locked to one. The address is the credential. On every node that runs the digest, put the value alone on the first line of a file owned by root:root with mode 600 (the digest refuses it otherwise, and refuses a symbolic link), add the lines below to /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf, then run --check and --test mattermost, which posts one message and sends no mail. Mail and the other channels are not affected.
setup.body_zh: 在 Mattermost 選「整合」>「Incoming Webhooks」>「新增」（系統管理員可能要先在 System Console 開啟 incoming webhooks），選擇頻道，複製網址（https://<伺服器>/hooks/...）。mattermost_channel（選用）可在 webhook 沒有鎖定頻道時改發到別的頻道。這個網址就是憑證。在每個執行摘要的節點上，把這個值單獨放在檔案第一行，擁有者 root:root、權限 600（否則摘要會拒用，也拒用符號連結），把下方設定加進 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf，再執行 --check 與 --test mattermost（發一則測試訊息，不寄信）。郵件與其他頻道不受影響。
setup.code:
( umask 077; read -rs -p 'Mattermost webhook URL: ' V; echo; printf '%s\n' "$V" > /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-mattermost.url )
chown root:root /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-mattermost.url
chmod 600 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-mattermost.url
echo 'mattermost_url_file = /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-mattermost.url' >> /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --check
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --test mattermost

setup.title: Optional: send the digest as JSON to any webhook
setup.title_zh: 選用：以 JSON 把摘要送到任何 webhook
setup.body: For a SOAR, a ticket queue or a script of your own. webhook_url is the receiver's https address (use webhook_url_file instead when the address itself carries a token). With webhook_hmac_key_file every request is signed: verify X-JT-Signature = "sha256=" + hex HMAC-SHA256(key, X-JT-Timestamp + "." + raw body) and reject old timestamps. webhook_bearer_file adds Authorization: Bearer. De-duplicate on X-JT-Delivery, which a retry repeats. The body is schema jt-alert-digest/1 (see the notes); treat every string in it as untrusted text. On every node that runs the digest, put the value alone on the first line of a file owned by root:root with mode 600 (the digest refuses it otherwise, and refuses a symbolic link), add the lines below to /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf, then run --check and --test webhook, which posts one message and sends no mail. Mail and the other channels are not affected.
setup.body_zh: 給 SOAR、工單系統或自己的腳本。webhook_url 是接收端的 https 網址（網址本身帶 token 時改用 webhook_url_file）。設定 webhook_hmac_key_file 後每個請求都會簽章：驗證 X-JT-Signature = "sha256=" 加上 HMAC-SHA256(金鑰, X-JT-Timestamp + "." + 原始 body) 的十六進位，並拒絕過舊的時間戳記。webhook_bearer_file 會加上 Authorization: Bearer。以 X-JT-Delivery 去重（重試時相同）。內容格式是 schema jt-alert-digest/1（見說明）；其中每個字串都要當成不可信的文字。在每個執行摘要的節點上，把這個值單獨放在檔案第一行，擁有者 root:root、權限 600（否則摘要會拒用，也拒用符號連結），把下方設定加進 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf，再執行 --check 與 --test webhook（發一則測試訊息，不寄信）。郵件與其他頻道不受影響。
setup.code:
( umask 077; openssl rand -hex 32 > /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-webhook.key )
chown root:root /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-webhook.key
chmod 600 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-webhook.key
cat >> /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf <<'EOF'
webhook_url = https://<receiver>/<path>
webhook_hmac_key_file = /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-webhook.key
EOF
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --check
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --test webhook
setup.verify: --test webhook sends one document with X-JT-Event: test, and the receiver's signature check accepts it.
setup.verify_zh: --test webhook 送出一份 X-JT-Event: test 的文件，而且接收端的簽章檢查接受它。

setup.title: Optional: push the digest to LINE
setup.title_zh: 選用：用 LINE 推播摘要
setup.body: In the LINE Developers console open the Messaging API channel of your LINE Official Account and issue a long-lived channel access token. line_to is a user id (U..., your own is on the channel's Basic settings page), a group id (C...) or a room id (R...). A group id is only given in a webhook event: point the channel's webhook URL at a receiver you control, invite the account to the group and read source.groupId from the join event. Every push counts against the monthly message quota, once per recipient: set line_level (for example 12) and keep the repeat hold on. On every node that runs the digest, put the value alone on the first line of a file owned by root:root with mode 600 (the digest refuses it otherwise, and refuses a symbolic link), add the lines below to /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf, then run --check and --test line, which posts one message and sends no mail. Mail and the other channels are not affected.
setup.body_zh: 在 LINE Developers 主控台開啟 LINE 官方帳號的 Messaging API channel，發行長期的 channel access token。line_to 可以是使用者 ID（U...，自己的 ID 在 channel 的 Basic settings 頁面）、群組 ID（C...）或聊天室 ID（R...）。群組 ID 只會出現在 webhook 事件裡：把 channel 的 Webhook URL 暫時指到你能看到請求的接收端，把官方帳號邀進群組，從加入事件的 source.groupId 讀出。每一則推播都會計入每月訊息額度，而且依收件人計算：請設定 line_level（例如 12）並保留重複壓制。在每個執行摘要的節點上，把這個值單獨放在檔案第一行，擁有者 root:root、權限 600（否則摘要會拒用，也拒用符號連結），把下方設定加進 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf，再執行 --check 與 --test line（發一則測試訊息，不寄信）。郵件與其他頻道不受影響。
setup.code:
( umask 077; read -rs -p 'LINE channel access token: ' V; echo; printf '%s\n' "$V" > /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-line.token )
chown root:root /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-line.token
chmod 600 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-line.token
cat >> /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest.conf <<'EOF'
line_token_file = /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/jt-alert-digest-line.token
line_to = <C... or U...>
line_level = 12
EOF
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --check
/usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-alert-digest.py --test line
setup.verify: --check shows "line auth: accepted as <account>" and the group's name; --test line pushes one message (counted against the quota).
setup.verify_zh: --check 顯示「line auth: accepted as <帳號>」與群組名稱；--test line 推播一則訊息（會計入額度）。

setup.title: Turn wazuh-maild off once the digest arrives
setup.title_zh: 摘要信寄達後關閉 wazuh-maild
setup.body: Otherwise both send. Set <email_notification>no</email_notification> in ossec.conf, then stop the daemon; the rest of the manager does not need a restart. Do not raise email_alert_level to silence maild: the digest reads that value too.
setup.body_zh: 否則兩邊都會寄。在 ossec.conf 設定 <email_notification>no</email_notification>，再停止該 daemon 即可，管理端其他部分不需重啟。不要用調高 email_alert_level 的方式讓 maild 安靜：摘要信也讀這個值。
